ops_jen: FYI customer reported Console shows 0 traffic for their private VPC tenant after auth rotation. Charts: total requests 0 for last 24h. They escalated to P1.

sam: Which customer/org? do we have an example request/trace? If they can share curl or trace id that helps.

ops_jen: org_id=acme-inc (redacted). customer sent a curl to /v1/metrics/tenant with X-Redwood-Tenant header. Response is 204 now. Paste logs:

ops_jen: ```
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2026 18:12:34 GMT
x-request-id: rq_abc123
``` 

maya: I noticed a gateway auth rotation rolled yesterday at 17:50. Deploy-bot: rolled auth-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 . Could be header canonicalization change.

deploy-bot: deploy auth-proxy v2.4.0 to prod (rolled at 2026-03-15T17:50:23Z) :rocket:

sam: Can you check sidecar/proxy logs for 401 or header-drop around rq_abc123? grep for request id and for 'X-Redwood-Tenant' rewrite.

ops_jen: grabbed sidecar logs, saw upstream 401 and message 'missing tenant header' between 17:50:25 - 17:51:10. snippet:

ops_jen: ```
[2026-03-15T17:50:26Z] WARN gateway proxy request_id=rq_abc123 upstream_status=401 msg="tenant header missing"
[2026-03-15T17:50:26Z] DEBUG route=private-vpc headers_before={"X-Forwarded-For":"...","User-Agent":"curl/7.88"} headers_after={}
```

maya: That headers_after={} looks like rewrite swallowed all custom headers for VPC routes. We changed canonicalization rules for auth tokens; might have interacted with tenant header passthrough.

eng-infra: Repro steps: curl against gateway with X-Redwood-Tenant -> 204 if header stripped. Workaround: include tenant id in query param `?tenant_id=` until we fix.

support-lead: Flagging to SEV team and creating internal ticket INFRA-4982. Customer on P1, billing impact. @ben-oncall can you take?

ben-oncall: Taking. I'll patch the header-preserve rule and roll a hotfix to auth-proxy in prod. ETA ~30m. Will monitor console metrics for return.

sam: Thx. Once fixed, ask customer to resend a few requests or we'll backfill metrics if we have raw telemetry. Confirming we have raw request logs for that window?

eng-infra: We have raw request logs in s3 partitioned by date. If hotfix shows metrics returning, we'll run batch job to compute missing aggregates.

ops_jen: Customer updated slack: they can see partial traffic for last 15m already. I'll update incident and keep on P1.

ben-oncall: Patch applied at 18:12:10Z. auth-proxy now preserves X-Redwood-Tenant for VPC routes. Monitoring dashboards show spikes returning to normal.

ops_jen: awesome, customer is unblocked. please follow up with postmortem and timeline.

maya: will investigate root cause; likely regression in header canonicalization rule set. I'll include test to prevent this in automated e2e.

support-lead: thanks everyone :heart:
